mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 months
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 months, but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals strong demand in the housing sector, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY > 10% and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1% YoY, it signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY < 1% and INDPRO YoY < -1%, but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
